description: Create, update, publish or unpublish a public Web Page or Web Form (website visitors see it; created unpublished, needs approval)

operation.description: delete only for an unpublished record (it is the undo of a create); disable = unpublish

name.description: Record name; required except for create (default: the title in lower-case-with-dashes)

route.description: URL path without the leading slash, ASCII: offers/summer-2026. Must not be a Desk/API path, an app page (login, contact…) or another page's route

published.description: Default false. true makes it visible to anyone on the internet (high risk); only when the user asked to publish

allow_scripts.description: Only when the user explicitly wants active content (<script>, event handlers, iframes, javascript field): turns those criticals into high-risk warnings

content.description: Web Page only: the body in content_type. Jinja ({{ }}) is rendered for anonymous visitors: formatting only (frappe.utils.*, frappe.format_value, _())

javascript.description: Web Page only; needs allow_scripts: true

dynamic_template.description: Web Page only: render the content as Jinja

doc_type.description: Web Form only: the DocType the form creates records of

form_fields.description: Web Form only: fields of doc_type in order ({fieldname} is enough: label, type and options come from the DocType). Layout rows: {fieldtype: 'Section Break'|'Column Break'|'Page Break', label}

login_required.description: Web Form only; default true. false = a public form anyone on the internet can submit (needs allow_guest)

allow_guest.description: Web Form only: explicit consent to login_required false (edit and list are then forced off)

success_url.description: Relative path; another site is warned

client_script.description: Web Form only: checked by the JavaScript analyzer

purpose.description: One line: why the user wants it (shown on the card)
